final_findings.name: Imaging Site-of-Service Policy
reasons: Stored allowed totals and claim-line counts independently reproduce exactly.
Stored PMPM = selected allowed / tenant-wide enrollment member-months (~5.55M).
Per-line allowed amounts align with synthetic fee schedules (e.g. 72148 ~$900).

Metric is book-level service allowed PMPM (numerator=policy services; denominator=whole enrolled book). It is not PMPM among a policy-eligible subpopulation. Claimant-enrollment PMPM is much higher (e.g. 177.19).
